name: VAE Encode
description: Turns an image into a latent with the model's VAE, for a Sampler to redraw from (image to image). With a mask, the latent carries it and the picture, and the Sampler redraws only the masked part.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The part to redraw, white; the rest stays as it is. A picture model made for inpainting (FLUX.1 Fill, SDXL Inpaint) reads it as it is; any other redraws only this part at each step. It must be the size of the image. Nothing painted is an error.
